ai_summary: Here's an executive summary of the financial document:  Beta Drugs Ltd. demonstrated strong Q1 FY27 financial performance with significant revenue (+25.2%), EBITDA (+39.1%), and PAT (+41.0%) growth, alongside improved margins, driven by core oncology strength and strategic diversification into IVF and Dermatology. This expansion includes a material acquisition in the IVF segment and is supported by a substantial increase in borrowings over the last two fiscal years, primarily via Convertible Compulsorily Debentures, which appears to fund strategic growth rather than signal immediate distress, as reflected in current healthy profit growth and declining finance costs.
